label: Design
headline: Crafting first websites for dentists and food businesses.
story: My journey started in visual design and front-end craft — building websites for dental clinics, food brands, and small businesses that needed a professional presence online. Every layout had to feel intentional: typography, color, and structure working together so local clients could trust what they saw on screen.

label: Hardware / Side
headline: Building Magic Globe and robotics at college and SENAI.
story: During my bachelor's degree and technical training at SENAI, I went deep into hardware: 3D printing, laser CNC, Arduino IoT, computer vision, and mechatronics. The Magic Globe — a Rubik's Cube solving robot controlled from a web app on an iPad — became the project that proved I could bridge software, electronics, and physical machines.

label: IdeYou
headline: Scaling food-tech and enterprise systems for real clients.
story: I returned to the food industry with IdeYou — this time building platforms, not just pages. MioDelivery grew into a full delivery and POS stack; Telecom ERP handled billing and operations for a major client; Aurélio brought lesson planning into schools. Complex problems, long-term relationships, systems that had to work every day.

label: Teaching
headline: Teaching CS while opening doors to school IT contracts.
story: The economy pushed me to rethink income — and the educational system gave me room to teach computer science while building the relationships that led to school contracts: networks, electrical work, custom systems, and IT services. CTI became a hub where students and real projects lived side by side.

label: Platform
headline: Unifying everything under the isaque.it platform.
story: Everything converged into a cohesive platform: admin SPA, client portal, NestJS API, push notifications, barcode generation — one ecosystem under isaque.it. Built with React, TypeScript, and the same attention to detail I learned designing dentist websites a decade ago.
